title: core/Item: a field colliding with a method now throws, not silently skips

set.request: refinement to the fields decision: static fields is code-only; a name colliding with any method/accessor/property anywhere in the prototype chain throws a clear error at register() time instead of silently being skipped; add one test
steps: edit Item.js: define_fields() walks the whole prototype chain, throws on a real collision, stays idempotent on its own prior accessor
add Item.test.mjs: clean field, same-class collision, inherited collision, idempotent re-register
verify: node test, live headless smoke test of /framework/
set.outcome:
**Fields are code-only; a collision throws** — [Item](/framework/core/Item/)

- [x] `static fields` stays code-only — nothing at runtime adds an accessor (already true; confirmed by reading `apply()`/`set_one()`)
- [x] a name check walks the WHOLE prototype chain (methods, accessors, properties), not just the class's own prototype
- [x] a real collision throws a clear error naming the class and the kind: `field "move" on Bad collides with method Bad.move`
- [x] re-registering the same class stays safe — its own prior accessor is recognized, not treated as a collision
- [x] one test: [Item.test.mjs](/framework/core/Item/Item.test.mjs), 4 assertions, `node public/framework/core/Item/Item.test.mjs`

Verified live, headless (no owner tab open): [/framework/](/framework/) still renders — Page's real fields register with no throw. Design doc, fifth pass: [page-item-design.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/page-item-design.md).
